summary: Preserve flat JSON contract for large pinned code2llm exports

delivery.outcome: Produce the declared analysis.json artifact even when pinned code2llm would automatically chunk a large Python package export.
nonGoals: No project imports, directory-name guessing, namespace guessing or blanket workspace profile
No standard/tool installation, CI/hook/permission changes or foreign edits

architecture.decision: Select explicit --no-chunk in the fixed pinned code2llm command. Preserve schema, version, source, shared-scope, atomic publication and byte budget checks.
architecture.rollback: Protected revert of this compatibility correction.

commands: PYTHONPATH=src python -m wellman.analyzer_snapshot ROOT --output STORE --python PINNED_PYTHON
validation.evidence: Actual Planfile pinned three-tool scan reproduces missing flat JSON before fix; corrected scan publishes only complete source-bound artifacts.
Existing meaningful failure regressions, full suite, Ruff/governance, independent protected exact-head delivery.
